title: Ray-Traced glTF Animation in WebGPU with Rust and WGSL
description: Ray trace an animated glTF character in WebGPU: CPU-skin Jax, rebuild a median BVH, traverse it in WGSL, cast shadows, and accumulate reflections.
imageAlt: Animated Jax rabbit character ray traced between reflective orange and blue spheres, cyan and yellow boxes, and a checkerboard floor.
